author.name: Sergio Miranda Freire

id5.description: A person's relationships, especially family ties.

id11.text: Birth, death, documentation and other demographic data
id11.description: Allows the collection of data about birth and death data, documentation and other person's demographic data.

id31.description: Addresses linked to a single contact, i.e., with the same time validity.

id41.description: Defines the type of relationship between related persons.

ac1.description: Valid codes for type of relationship.

at13.description: is normally used for babies for whom sex has not been determined for whatever reason, should not generally be used on data collection forms completed by the respondent and should only be used if the person or respondent volunteers that the person is intersex or where it otherwise becomes clear during the collection process that the individual is neither male nor female

at14.description: is not to be used on primary collection forms. It is primarily for use in administrative collections when transferring data from data sets where the item has not been collected.

id2.description: The date of birth of a person

id4.description: An indicator of multiple birth, showing the total number of births resulting from a single pregnancy

id7.description: Additional birth data that are country specific

id3.description: The person's identifying name(s) within the family group or by which he/she is uniquely socially identified.

id4.description: The part of a name a person usually has in common with some other members of his/her family, as distinguished from his/her given names.

id5.description: An honorific form of address commencing a name, used when addressing a person by name, whether by mail, by phone, or depending upon cultural situation in person.

id8.description: Details of alternative representations such as local codesets or language variations.

id11.description: The person's full name as a concatenation of its name parts.

id22.description: Name of the representational form used.

id23.description: Alternative Representation of this subject of care name using alternative styles of representation such as characters or language character set variations for local display.

at24.description: The subject’s name as it is to be used for reporting, when used with a specific identifier.

at25.description: A type reserved for the identification of unnamed newborn babies.

at26.description: The name used by the subject for business or professional purposes.

at27.description: The name used by the subject of care prior to marriage.

at29.description: Any other name by which the subject is known, or has been known by in the past.

at32.description: The name recorded is a fictitious or partial name.

at33.description: This is a misspelling, but should be retained for potential future matching.

at34.description: This name should not be used when referring to this subject.

at35.description: By Law, this name and all names prior to it in the name sequence are not to be displayed or indicated in any way when searching for or dealing with information and events associated with a name that is subsequent to this one in the name sequence.

at36.description: A name for which episodes are attached that should only be accessible to specified authorised persons.

at37.description: A temporary name issued where the subject's name has not been determined.

id1.1.description: Person name for Simple discharge summary

id3.description: A composite of one or more standard address components that describe a low level of geographical/physical description of a location that, used in conjunction with the other high-level address components i.e. ‘suburb / town / locality name’, ‘postal code’, ‘state / territory / province’, and ‘country’, forms a complete geographical/physical address.

id5.description: The code for a postal delivery area, aligned with locality, suburb or place for the address, as defined by the postal service.

id6.description: The full name of the general locality containing the specific address.

id8.description: A code representing the country component of an address.

id11.description: Local high level address components. Archetypes that include other elements not present in ISO/TS22220 to meet local needs like county/parish, etc.

id22.description: The specification of the type of a separately identifiable portion within a building/complex, marina etc. to clearly distinguish it from another.

id23.description: The specification of the number of identifier of a building/complex, marina etc. to clearly distinguish it from another.

id24.description: The full name used to identify the physical building or property as part of its location.

id25.description: Descriptor used to identify the floor or level of a multi-storey building/complex.

id26.description: Descriptor used to classify the type of floor or level of a multi-storey building/complex.

id28.description: A code that identifies the type of public thoroughfare.

id29.description: The name that identifies a public thoroughfare and differentiates it from others in the same suburb/town/locality.

id30.description: The numeric or string reference number of a house or property that is unique within a street name, suburb.

id31.description: Term used to qualify the street name suitable for directional references.

id33.description: Local address line components. Archetypes that include other elements not present in ISO/TS22220 to meet local needs.

at462.description: Used to indicate an address that is the physical location of a business or office at which an entity can be contacted.

at463.description: Used to indicate an address that is only for correspondence and/or billing purposes.

at464.description: Temporary accomodation address (such as for a person who usually resides overseas or where the provider of the address is in temporary accomodation due to renovation or treatment).

at465.description: Used to indicate where a person is living. Note that this code is not valid for organisations.

at466.description: Used where a person has no fixed address.

at467.description: Unknown/not stated/inadequately described may also be used where the person has no fixed address or does not wish to have their residential or correspondence address recorded.

ac1.description: Valid codes for types of buildings.
